title: its peeling !!
text:
its peeling !!. I have had this ice cream scoop for 3 years, and we do not use it that offen.

Now I see that the chrome is peeling off in the middle of the scoop part!!!

I have no idea why this would happen??

Other wise we like it, but now I'm wondering what is underneath this and is it not safe to use?...

I'm now thinking is 3 stars too much!!

product_metadata.title: KitchenAid Ice Cream Scoop, White
features: Cuts through frozen ice cream with ease
Perfect for making sundaes and banana splits
Cast head for strength and durability
description: Cuts through frozen ice cream with ease / Great for making sundaes and banana splits / Cast head for strength and durability / Loop handle for storage

How many times have you bent a cheap spoon in a rock-hard pint of ice cream? You need a sturdy scoop like this one to get the job done. The comfortably wide 6-inch-long handle makes for a more powerful grip, and the capacious bowl is almost 3 inches deep--big enough for the most ambitious helping of mocha chip. There's no release lever to get the ice cream out of the scoop, but otherwise, this is the perfect tool for that anonymous midnight raid on your icebox. I scream, you scream....
